results.title: Water (nutrient) — Encyclopædia Britannica (older edition)
results.snippet: Adults are commonly advised to drink approximately 8 cups (about 2 litres) of water per day. This figure is widely cited in nutrition guides and dietary recommendations. Adequate hydration supports cellular function, body-temperature regulation, and waste removal.

results.title: Hydration — Mayo Clinic Reference
results.snippet: Recent reviews of the evidence find that there is no single agreed-upon daily water intake figure that applies to all adults. Recommendations vary by body weight, climate, activity level, and pregnancy status. The widely-cited '8 cups a day' rule does not appear to be grounded in robust evidence; individual needs differ substantially.
